sn42.1:1.2: Atha kho caṇḍo gāmaṇi yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 3 Ekam antam nisinno kho caṇḍo gāmaṇi Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn42.1:1.3: Ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yenam-idhekacco Caṇḍo teva saṅkhaṃ gacchati ||
sn42.1:1.4: ko pana hetu ko paccayo yena-m-idhekacco Sūrato teva saṅkhaṃ gacchatīti || || 4
sn42.1:1.5: Idha kho gāmaṇi ekaccassa rāgo appahīno hoti ||
sn42.1:1.6: rāgassa appahīnattā pare kopenti || parehi kopiyamāno kopam pātukaroti ||
sn42.1:1.9: dosassa appahīnattā pare kopenti || parehi kopiyamāno kopam pātukaroti ||
sn42.1:1.12: mohassa appahīnattā pare kopenti || parehi kopiyamāno kopam pātukaroti ||
sn42.1:1.14: Ayaṃ kho gāmaṇi hetu ayam paccayo yena-m-idhekacco Caṇḍo teva saṅkhaṃ gacchati || || 5
sn42.1:2.1: Idha pana gāmaṇi ekaccassa rāgo pahīno hoti ||
sn42.1:2.2: rāgassa pahīnattā pare na kopenti || parehi akopiyamāno kopaṃ na pātukaroti ||
sn42.1:2.5: dosassa pahīnattā pare na kopenti || parehi akopiyamāno kopaṃ na pātukaroti ||
sn42.1:2.8: mohassa pahīnattā pare na kopenti || parehi akopiyamāno kopaṃ na pātukaroti ||
sn42.1:2.10: Ayaṃ kho gāmaṇi hetu ayam paccayo yeva-m-idhekacco Sūrato teva saṅkhaṃ gacchatī ti || || 6
sn42.1:3.1: Evaṃ vutte caṇḍo gamaṇi Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn42.1:3.3: Seyyathāpi bhante nikujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya mūḷhassa vā maggam ācikkheyya andhakare vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhanti || evam eva Bhagavatā anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito || ||
sn42.1:3.4: Esāham bhante Bhagavantam saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañ ca bhikkhusaṅghañ ca
sn42.1:3.5: upāsakam mam Bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatanti || || 1
